betaNotes:
1.3.0 (46) beta: Offline React builds with the documented npm command subset. In Examples > Offline frontend > React + Gin study board, open Terminal: npm install --offline, then npm run build, and Output > Open full screen. React/React DOM/scheduler are bundled; no registry, Node runtime or Bun. Optional gin-replay recipes connect explicit local paths to real Go handlers without sockets; deterministic API state is reconstructed through up to 64 mutations. An external GitHub project verified read/create/update/delete but is NOT included in the app.

Source debugger beta: open Source debugger walkthrough, tap gutter line 12, then Run. Without breakpoints Run behaves normally; with them it automatically debugs. Test Continue, Into/Over/Out, Stop, own-source stack and current-frame locals. Breakpoints persist per project; temporary probes never overwrite source. No conditional breakpoints, expression watches or vendor/stdlib stepping. Debug runs are not performance measurements.

Check saved projects, ordinary Go run/test and learning Continue. API preview state is temporary and shared between preview sizes; rebuilding/reopening the project resets it.
